Definition: Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Esau = "hairy"; 1) eldest son of Isaac and Rebecca and twin brother of Jacob; sold the birthright for food when he was hungry and the divine blessing went to Jacob; progenitor of the Arab peoples
